info.name: PBL6 API Test Report Final - Auth and SeatHold
info.description: Maps the 16 cases in Software testing/API_Test_Report.xlsx (AUTH-01..07 and BOOK-01..09). AUTH-06 and BOOK-09 use local database time-shift fixtures to avoid natural OTP/hold TTL waits; BOOK-09 waits at most 20 seconds for the 15-second proactive expiry worker. Only newly generated test rows are changed. Requires local API, Mailpit, Docker Compose PostgreSQL and seeded fixtures.

item.name: AUTH-05 - Verify OTP and activate account

exec: pm.test('AUTH-07 sixth resend is limited and has Retry-After',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(429);pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('RATE_LIMITED');pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After'))).to.be.above(0)});

item.name: BOOK-01 - Read seat list and statuses

exec: pm.test('BOOK-01 returns seat statuses, timestamps and prices',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.seats.length).above(0);pm.expect(b.availabilityAsOf).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.serverTime).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.seats.some(s=>s.status==='AVAILABLE')).to.eql(true);pm.expect(b.seats.some(s=>s.status==='BOOKED')).to.eql(true);pm.expect(b.seats.every(s=>['AVAILABLE','HELD','BOOKED','DISABLED'].includes(s.status))).to.eql(true);pm.expect(b.seats.every(s=>Number.isInteger(s.price.amount)&&s.price.currency==='VND')).to.eql(true);pm.collectionVariables.set('r3seatA','01990a00-0000-7000-8000-000000000043');pm.collectionVariables.set('r3seatB','01990a00-0000-7000-8000-000000000044')});

console.log('BOOK02 response '+pm.response.text());pm.test('One seat hold returns token, expiry, seat price and policy snapshot',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(201);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.holdToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.seats).to.have.length(1);pm.expect(b.seats[0].price).to.exist;pm.expect(b.policySnapshot).to.be.an('object');pm.expect(b.policySnapshot.policyVersion).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.expect(b.policySnapshot).to.have.property('allowPayLater');pm.collectionVariables.set('r3hold02',b.holdToken);});if(pm.response.code===201)pm.collectionVariables.set('r3hold02',pm.response.json().holdToken);

pm.test('Both seats held atomically with one hold token',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(201);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.holdToken).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.seats).to.have.length(2);pm.expect(b.seats.every(x=>x.status==='HELD')).to.eql(true);pm.collectionVariables.set('r3hold03',b.holdToken);});

item.name: BOOK-04 Customer 1 multiseat attempt is all-or-nothing
BOOK-04 Verify available seat was not partially held
BOOK-05 Concurrent requests from two customers

exec: const base=pm.variables.get('baseUrl'),trip=pm.variables.get('holdTripId'),seat=pm.variables.get('seatId2A');const url=base+'/trips/'+trip+'/seat-holds';const body=JSON.stringify({seatIds:[seat],pickupStopId:'01990a00-0000-7000-8000-000000000004',dropoffStopId:'01990a00-0000-7000-8000-000000000005'});const headers=(t,k)=>({'Authorization':'Bearer '+t,'Idempotency-Key':k,'Content-Type':'application/json'});let result=[];const done=(err,res)=>{result.push({err:!!err,code:res&&res.code,body:res&&res.json()});if(result.length===2){pm.test('Concurrent seat hold: exactly one winner and one conflict',()=>{pm.expect(result.every(x=>!x.err)).to.eql(true);pm.expect(result.map(x=>x.code).sort()).to.eql([201,409]);});const win=result.find(x=>x.code===201);if(win&&win.body&&win.body.holdToken){pm.sendRequest({url:base+'/seat-holds/'+win.body.holdToken,method:'DELETE',header:headers(pm.collectionVariables.get('r3c1'),'r3-book05-cleanup-'+Date.now())},(e,r)=>console.log('race cleanup',e&&e.message,r&&r.code));}}};pm.sendRequest({url,method:'POST',header:headers(pm.collectionVariables.get('r3c1'),'r3-book05-c1-'+Date.now()),body:{mode:'raw',raw:body}},done);pm.sendRequest({url,method:'POST',header:headers(pm.collectionVariables.get('r3c2'),'r3-book05-c2-'+Date.now()),body:{mode:'raw',raw:body}},done);

item.name: BOOK-08 Replay identical key and body
BOOK-07 - Reject hold on departed trip
BOOK-09 - Create hold for accelerated expiry fixture

exec: pm.test('BOOK-09 test hold created for local expiry fixture',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(201);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.holdToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.collectionVariables.set('book09HoldToken',b.holdToken);for(let i=0;i<b.holdToken.length;i+=12)console.log('BOOK09_PART'+(Math.floor(i/12)+1)+'='+b.holdToken.slice(i,i+12))});

item.name: BOOK-09 - Read seats after accelerated expiry fixture
BOOK-09 - Read hold after accelerated expiry fixture

exec: pm.test('BOOK-09 proactive hold created for worker expiry fixture',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(201);const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(b.holdToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;pm.collectionVariables.set('book09ProactiveHoldToken',b.holdToken);for(let i=0;i<b.holdToken.length;i+=12)console.log('BOOK09_PROACTIVE_PART'+(Math.floor(i/12)+1)+'='+b.holdToken.slice(i,i+12))});
